description_en: Queries AgentSpec resources in a specified workspace by using paging, supporting name search, sorting, and filtering by owner, visibility scope, and business labels
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的 AgentSpec，支持名称搜索、排序以及按所有者、可见范围和业务标签筛选
name: ListAgentSpecs

parameters.help_en: The AgentSpec name used as a search keyword. Use this parameter together with the search parameter
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpec 名称，作为搜索关键词（配合 search 参数使用）
parameters.name: agent_spec_name

parameters.help_en:
The search mode. Valid values:

accurate: exact match.
blur: fuzzy match.

Default value: blur
parameters.help_zh: 搜索模式：accurate（精确匹配）或 blur（模糊匹配），默认模糊
parameters.name: search

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort results. Set this parameter to download_count to sort by download count. By default, results are sorted by update time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，支持 download_count，默认按更新时间排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The owner used to filter results
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en:
The visibility scope used to filter results. Valid values:

PUBLIC
PRIVATE
parameters.help_zh: 可见范围筛选：PUBLIC 或 PRIVATE
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The business tag used for fuzzy filtering
parameters.name: biz_tag

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the Skills and McpServers lists. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回 Skills 和 McpServers 列表，默认 false
parameters.name: with_capabilities
